    goals and outcomes.

    members.

  - Description: Team members participate in a community service project such as cleaning up a local park or volunteering at a food bank, working together to give back to the community.

  - Date: 2024-12-13
  - Time: 09:00 - 13:00

  - Description: Teams are locked in themed escape rooms and must solve puzzles, find clues, and work together under time pressure to escape.
  - Objective: To improve collaboration, communication under pressure, and critical thinking skills in a fun, immersive environment.
  - Location: Downtown Escape Quest
  - Date: 2024-12-20
  - Time: 15:00 - 17:00
